lines.en: I sidestep like a crab
My two claws arrive before I do
My shell clicks against the stones
I follow the cracks in the originium
Many legs, and still slow

lines.zh: 我一只钳举着，一只垂着
lines.en: One claw up, one hanging
I tread the gravel steadily
This shell is heavy

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下刮痕
lines.en: My passing leaves scrape marks
I edge sideways through a gap
My claw taps the ground now and then
I head toward the noise

lines.zh: 我顺着石头的边绕过去
lines.en: I work my way around the edge of a stone
I crouch, claws drawn in
The originium glow sits on my shell
I open and close one claw slowly
There are fine cracks on my shell
I wait for someone to touch me
It is quiet here, and wrong
My pincers wait for the second blow.
My claws are smarter than I am
I am deciding when to clamp
The legs under my shell never stop
I taste the bitter originium smell
I am only waiting here
This shell protects me

lines.zh: 两只钳子交替敲着石面。
lines.en: My two pincers tap the stone in turn.
Bits of my shell lie on the ground
You watch me, and I watch you
One of my claws has risen
I have seen what you hold
Do not touch my shell

lines.zh: 我这身甲不是给人摸的
lines.en: This armor is not for petting
You stand so close I cannot back off
I turn my side toward you
My eyes sit on stalks
Move once and I will know
Before you come closer, look at my pincers.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，两只钳子先到。
lines.en: I sidle, and both claws arrive first.
This is not your place
I lifted two of my feet
You have an old scar on your hand
One piece of originium lies between us
I am about to clamp something
Do not be in a hurry to leave

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，钳子先记住。
lines.en: I know your scent; my tongs remember it first.
Speak, and I will listen
Everything about me is hard
Originium light seeps from the crack.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，钳子还举着
lines.en: I back two steps, claws still up
That landed on me
I pull my claws in
A little shell chips to the ground
It hurts, and I want to clamp back
I turn broadside to shield
My legs are trembling
I will remember that clamp
Do not think I only take hits
Is that iron
Offer a bit of it
I do not eat it, I only want to clamp
That piece in your hand has a nice ring
Set it down, I will come slowly
I do not snatch, I wait
This is too soft, useless
A little further forward

lines.zh: 你把东西给我，我就让路
lines.en: Give me the thing and I will clear the way
My claw is clicking

lines.zh: 这点东西不够我夹一下
lines.en: Not enough for one clamp
I want to test how solid it is
Hold it still
This is not food, do not mistake it
I sniffed it, it has some interest
Fine, I will take it
This piece is mine
You touched my shell
I turn to face you at once
My claw is up

lines.zh: 钳子一夹，把你挡开半格。
lines.en: My pincer closes and shoves you back half a block.
The shell is hard, does your hand hurt
I retreat half a step, still here

lines.zh: 你撞上来的时候我听见了
lines.en: I heard you coming in
I turn broadside to block
My legs slipped on the stone

lines.zh: 钳子张开，我横在路中间。
lines.en: My pincers open; I block the path.
When kin meet, we compare claws
My pair is not the largest

lines.zh: 一起趴着，谁也碰不到谁
lines.en: Lying together, neither touches the other
Shell against shell is a greeting
There are many of us near the originium

lines.zh: 我们不结伴，只是同一片
lines.en: We do not pair, we just share the ground
It moved away, and so did I

lines.zh: 两只钳子对着，谁也不先动
lines.en: Two claws facing off, neither moves
Kin need few words

lines.zh: 我们各自守各自的石头
lines.en: Each of us keeps a stone
I have it in my claw
Too small, my claw cannot hold it
It took three tries to grip
It crumbled once lifted
Claws raised to my eyes; now I see it.
This is iron, I want it
I catch it with the other claw
I can clamp anything that falls
I tuck it under my shell
Walking with it is awkward
That thing moved
I raise both claws

lines.zh: 有东西踏进了我的地方
lines.en: Something stepped into my ground

lines.zh: 钳子一张，三十点就出去。
lines.en: One snap of these pincers is thirty damage.
I do not like that smell
It is too close to my stone
I shift one step that way
My shell already faces it

lines.zh: 我钳子上的牙全张开了
lines.en: The teeth of my claws are open
I have waited for this
I move sideways step by step
My claws stay open
It comes closer, and I wait
My shell is up front
I have many legs, I hold steady
Raise a claw and I answer.

lines.zh: 你打一下，我这钳子就还回来。
lines.en: You hit once, my claw returns it.
This stone is mine
It breathes harder than I do
One more move and it is in reach
The claws shut, and clamped
I twist hard
This clamp can crush stone
I ram it broadside
The edge of my shell rakes it
It is clamped and cannot retreat
I release and clamp again
That made a loud sound
My claws are a little dull now
It carries a mark now

lines.zh: 我从源石的裂缝里爬出来
lines.en: I crawl out of a crack in the originium
My shell is still new
I clamp at the air first
Plenty of stone here, just right
I tap the ground with a claw

lines.zh: 壳上的碎屑还没掉干净
lines.en: Crumbs of shell still cling to me

lines.zh: 我从岩缝里侧身挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze sideways out of the rock crack.
I know the ground here
Both of my claws are open
I slowly raise my head to look

lines.zh: 火烧到我的壳，发出响声
lines.en: Fire hits my shell with a crackle
I flip over, legs kicking air
Water floods my shell seams, heavy
The blast flips me onto my shell
Something flying sticks in my shell
That force slips through a seam

lines.zh: 没有东西可夹，我越来越轻
lines.en: Nothing to clamp, I grow lighter
Lightning runs over my shell, I cannot move

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石头可以靠
lines.en: No stone to brace against in the void
